intro: On October 12, 2026 the QuantAura four-model ensemble published a HOLD call on Bitcoin at 60.5 percent confidence.

days: Twenty-four hours later the price had moved -2.63 percent, so the call was graded incorrect.
A HOLD call counts as correct only when price stays within ±1 percent over the 24-hour horizon.
trend: Going into the day, the public record stood at 29 hits and 39 misses over 68 graded calls, an accuracy of 42.6 percent.
